comment: Cue sheet for the 30-second opening: start second + spoken text. Each title is the first spoken sentence.

cues.text: You stock your booth before the crowd arrives, and you guess. Eight thousand people, twelve products, one budget. Who is actually coming?
Ask Qloo who the crowd is. Let the agent stock for them. Every product decision cites Qloo: films, audience age, and taste.
Who's coming, what they like, what to stock. Qloo profiles the crowd, the agent decides, the optimizer sets quantities.
